name: Data exfiltration via application / API
description: Customer or confidential data pulled out through a web application, API, or misconfigured cloud service.

steps.text: Pull WAF, API gateway and application logs for the abused endpoint; identify every source IP, token and request in the window.
Scope the data: which fields and how many records/people were returned; does it include personal data, and from which countries?
Check for further access beyond the API (pivoting into internal systems) using EDR and identity logs.
Close the hole: disable the vulnerable endpoint or feature flag, and block attacker IPs at the WAF/perimeter.
Revoke and rotate any API keys, tokens or service credentials that could have been exposed.
Fix the root cause (authentication check, input validation) and retest before re-enabling; add monitoring for bulk responses.
Enable fraud monitoring on affected accounts and prepare customer communications with the DPO.
Review the release process that allowed the misconfiguration (feature-flag hygiene, pre-release security tests).
